versions.changelog: DEPRECATED: functionality merged into doc-process v4.0.0. Use doc-process for all document scanning, perspective correction, and dewarping. The doc-process scanner has improved multi-strategy edge detection, sub-pixel corner refinement, and better scan-quality output.

Initial release of Doc-Scan: a Microsoft Lens-style document scanning skill.

- Converts photos of documents into clean, professional-looking scanned pages.
- Automatically detects document edges, applies perspective correction/dewarping, and enhances contrast.
- Supports single and multi-page batches, with output as PNG, JPEG, or PDF.
- Flags non-document images and provides user guidance.
- Includes pre- and post-scan assessment and quality checks.
- Offers multiple enhancement options: black & white, color, or grayscale.
